text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is a technology that allows computers to think and learn in ways similar to humans. Machine learning is a part of AI where computers learn from data without being told exactly what to do. Deep learning, a more advanced form, uses large neural networks to solve very complex problems. Today, AI is everywhere in daily life. It helps us unlock our phones with our faces, suggests movies we might enjoy, translates languages, and even assists doctors in finding diseases. AI is not just science fiction; it is already changing how we live and work.
